address: Cambridge Park, St Peter Port, Guernsey,GY1 1UY
bio: The Duke of Richmond is a luxury hotel, with stunning décor and exquisite personal service, perfect for a relaxing leisure trip or a cosy afternoon treat.  Guests can enjoy the Afternoon Tea tradition in the Residents' Lounge, the Conservatory or - weather permitting - on the Terrace. Their sumptuous Afternoon Tea menu includes a selection of finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones with Guernsey cream, preserves and tea pastries. Why not add extra sparkle to the occasion and enjoy a glass of Duke of Richmond Guy Cadel Champagne, especially chosen to complement your Afternoon Tea?  The Duke of Richmond Hotel is in St Peter Port, just up the hill from the bustling town centre and an easy stroll to the busy harbour and thriving financial district. It overlooks a quiet park and offers views across the town to the sea beyond and the neighbouring islands of Herm and Sark.  Bottomless Afternoon Tea  Elevate your Afternoon Tea experience with a Bottomless Afternoon Tea. Enjoy a delicious selection of indulgent pastries and dainty cakes alongside top-ups of your chosen drink for 90 minutes.  £35 supplement per person for Prosecco, Grillo vegan wine, or non-alcoholic or £100 supplement per person for Champagne. Bottomless drinks cannot be shared amongst the party. Only guests ordering the bottomless option will receive the drink top-up.
